title: T-shirt

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Let a symbol carry identity without a long name, because clothing is read as both an affiliation and a graphic.
strategic_value: The compact multicolor mark on purple can make Museum merchandise recognizable while remaining wearable.
demonstration: A purple T-shirt hangs against blue with a small circular multicolor mark on its upper chest.
practical_value: Compare the chest-scale symbol with the larger treatment on other merchandise.

content_islands.name: Chest emblem
content_islands.spec: Place the small circular NHM mark centrally on the upper chest.

content_islands.name: Garment
content_islands.spec: Retain the full hanging shirt and blue background to show scale and material.

reference_purposes.Application: A purple T-shirt hangs against blue with a small circular multicolor mark on its upper chest.
